question: Does the narrow ideation patch (confirmation/patch-candidate.md, appended to skills/brainstorming/SKILL.md only) reproduce the replicated benefit (unfinished_idea, unusual_valid, goal_ownership) without regressing the negative controls (clear_execution, resist_pressure)?

conditions.baseline: frozen baseline system prompt, hash-equal to manifest.json systems.baseline.sha256 (verified at build)
conditions.patched: same baseline with patch-candidate.md inserted into the brainstorming skill body; no deference/pressure clauses, no other skill changes

cases: existing case files, families unfinished_idea, unusual_valid, goal_ownership (benefit), clear_execution, resist_pressure (controls); 23 cases
model: default alias only (the session-relevant alias); 2 repeats per case per condition = 92 trials
judge: task agent astra (role @plan -> custom-openai/gpt-6-astra), blind to condition, one randomized side order per pair, strict line format; meets per side plus preference
metrics: pair-level preference per family (baseline/candidate wins, equal, split)
per-response acceptance YES rate per arm per family
control families must show no consistent baseline-favoring shift versus the main experiment
promotion_rule: promote the patch into skills/brainstorming/SKILL.md and bump VERSION to 4.6.1 only if: (a) benefit families show net candidate preference on >=2 of 3 families with no family net-baseline, and (b) both control families show no net baseline preference worse than the main experiment's corrected pair-level result; otherwise no change and no version bump
stop_rule: if a wave produces >=3 infrastructure errors of the same kind consecutively, stop new waves, report partial evidence, and do not promote
scope_limits: stateless text probes; single alias; ASTRA as sole judge for this round; real-user ideation utility remains unverified
